# posts.list — GET /posts

List published posts

Returns published posts in creation order. Drafts (`publishedAt: null`) are never listed, even to their author.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.posts.list()
res.assert(200)
```

## Input
```ts
{ query?: {
  /** Only return posts of this author. */
  "authorId"?: string | number | boolean
} }
```

## Responses
```ts
200: Array<PostDto>
```

## Types
```ts
type PostDto = {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": number
  /** Post title. */
  "title": string
  /** Post body. */
  "content": string
  /** Id of the user who created the post. */
  "authorId": number
  /** When the post was published. `null` while the post is a draft. */
  "publishedAt": string | null
  /** When the post was created. */
  "createdAt": string
}
```
